name: Premium Guardian Bot
description: High-speed Telegram Auto-Filter & File Delivery Bot with Automatic Telegram Stars Payment & Paywall.

ADMINS.description: Admin Telegram User IDs separated by space.

CHANNELS.description: Channel ID(s) for auto-indexing separated by space (e.g. -1001878553187).

LOG_CHANNEL.description: Bot log channel ID starting with -100.

PREMIUM_LOGS.description: Channel ID for automatic Telegram Stars payment logs (defaults to LOG_CHANNEL).

PAYWALL_ENABLED.description: Set True to require a paid subscription for all users, or False for free access.

ULTRA_FAST_MODE.description: Set True for high-speed pagination without full-collection count scans.

DATABASE_URI2.description: Optional secondary MongoDB URI (only required if MULTIPLE_DB is True).

COLLECTION_NAME.description: MongoDB collection name for indexed media.
